while true; do

        echo "[$(date)] Target PID $TARGET_PID no longer exists. Guard exiting." >> "$LOG"

            echo "[$(date)] Process still alive, sending SIGKILL..." >> "$LOG"
            kill -9 "$TARGET_PID" 2>/dev/null
        fi
        echo "[$(date)] Done. Guard exiting." >> "$LOG"
        exit 0
    fi

    sleep 60
done
